Two or three short paragraphs: the problem, what the application does about it, and who uses it.

Markdown is allowed. Write for a customer's IT admin who decides whether to install it.

architecture.description: Users reach the web app over HTTPS. It runs as a container app in a new Container Apps environment and writes logs to a Log Analytics workspace. The image is pulled with the registry token you enter in the form. Nothing leaves your subscription except the image pull.

requirements: Contributor on the target resource group
Azure Container Apps available in the selected region
Registry token from LinkCode (sent with the trial or licence)
cost: Idle: close to zero, the app scales to zero. Typical use: a few EUR per month for Container Apps and Log Analytics at Azure list prices. Check the [Azure pricing calculator](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/calculator/) for your region.
security:
- Data stays in your subscription and the region you choose.
- The app uses a managed identity; no secrets are stored in the template.
- Ingress is HTTPS only; restrict it with the "Allowed IP ranges" parameter if needed.
afterDeployment: Open the `appUrl` output in a browser.
Sign in with the admin account you entered in the form.
